name: Harvest Tycoon
summary:
Harvest Tycoon is a farming simulation set in a 3D valley, in which the player expands a few starting fields into a large estate. Crops grow in real time, from two minutes for wheat to a full day for sunflowers, and longer crops keep growing while the player is offline. Crops and animal produce such as eggs, milk, wool and honey are turned into goods in production buildings, then sold at a market whose prices change daily or delivered to customer orders, while quests, daily challenges and levels unlock new crops, buildings and helpers such as a tractor.

Players can join farm families of up to ten members that work toward shared weekly goals and compete in tournaments, take part in timed events in leagues of players at a similar level, fish at a farm pond and chat with other players. From level 100 a second world opens: a mountain village with its own market, crops, mine, forest, smithy and fishing lake. The game is free to play with optional in-game purchases, requires an internet connection, and keeps one farm per account across the web browser, Android and iOS versions.
